title: Principal-open finite-free model before derived reflection
statement: Let A be a commutative ring and M a cochain complex of A-modules. Fix derived categories [def-pc-derived-category] for structure-sheaf modules on X = Spec(A) [def-pc-scheme], on every localized open site of X, and on Spec(A_f), with independently chosen morphism universes for the latter. Let f be an element of A, let U be open with D(f) contained in U, and let P be a cochain complex of structure-sheaf modules on the localized site of U. Assume P is zero in every degree above some integer, each term is isomorphic to the free sheaf on a finite set, and the derived restriction of the termwise associated-sheaf complex of M is isomorphic to Q(P). Then there exist a cochain complex E of A_f-modules and an integer b such that E is strictly zero above b, every term is finite and free, and Q(tilde E) is isomorphic in the sheaf derived category on Spec(A_f) to Q(tilde(A_f tensor_A M)). This asserts only a sheaf-derived comparison, not a module-derived isomorphism.

source.place: Tag 08E7 (perfect-lemma-pseudo-coherent-affine), converse proof, local-model comparison; Tag 06Z0 for the affine derived comparison

proof.text: Restrict P and the supplied derived isomorphism to the principal open and transport it to Spec(A_f), obtaining a bounded-above finite-free sheaf complex C with Q(C) isomorphic to the localized tilde complex.
Apply the affine finite-free lift to C to obtain E over A_f, and compose its sheaf-complex isomorphism with the transport comparison.

theorem affine_pseudoCoherent_principal_sheaf_model (A : Type u) [CommRing A]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wX}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ V : (Spec (.of A)).Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{wX}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace).over V))]
    (M : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ) (f : A)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wY}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of (Localization.Away f))).toRingedSpace))]
    (U : (Spec (.of A)).Opens)
    (hf : PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f ≤ U)
    (P : CochainComplex
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace).over U)) ℤ)
    (hb : ∃ N : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, N < i → CategoryTheory.Limits.IsZero (P.X i))
    (hfree : ∀ i : ℤ, ∃ r : ℕ, Nonempty (P.X i ≅ SheafOfModules.free
      (R := (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace).over U) (ULift.{u} (Fin r))))
    (hiso : Nonempty ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
      (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.obj
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
          ((@Functor.mapHomologicalComplex ℤ (ModuleCat.{u} A)
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace))
            _ _ _ _ (tilde.functor (.of A))
            ⟨fun _ _ ↦ tilde.map_zero⟩ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj M)) ≅
      DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)) :
    ∃ E : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} (Localization.Away f)) ℤ,
      ∃ b : ℤ, E.IsStrictlyLE b ∧
        (∀ j : ℤ, Module.Free (Localization.Away f) (E.X j) ∧
          Module.Finite (Localization.Away f) (E.X j)) ∧
        Nonempty (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
          ((@Functor.mapHomologicalComplex ℤ (ModuleCat.{u} (Localization.Away f))
            (SheafOfModules.{u}
              (moduleRings (Spec (.of (Localization.Away f))).toRingedSpace))
            _ _ _ _ (tilde.functor (.of (Localization.Away f)))
            ⟨fun _ _ ↦ tilde.map_zero⟩ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj E) ≅
          DerivedCategory.Q.obj
            ((@Functor.mapHomologicalComplex ℤ (ModuleCat.{u} (Localization.Away f))
              (SheafOfModules.{u}
                (moduleRings (Spec (.of (Localization.Away f))).toRingedSpace))
              _ _ _ _ (tilde.functor (.of (Localization.Away f)))
              ⟨fun _ _ ↦ tilde.map_zero⟩ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
                ((Functor.mapHomologicalComplex
                  (ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap A (Localization.Away f)))
                  (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj M)))
